policy.method: Independent exact Fraction weighted sums; centered variance checked against second moment identity
policy.weights: Nonempty nonnegative integers with positive sum; openly normalized by total
policy.values: One finite numeric value per weight, at most two decimal places; Fraction(str(value))
policy.transform: Y=scale*X+shift; finite numeric scale and shift converted by Fraction(str(value))
policy.distribution: Original X values merged exactly, sorted ascending; zero-mass values omitted
policy.variance: Population variance: sum(w*(x-mean)^2)/sum(w), not sample variance
